item.title: Community Notice: SDG&E Utility Pole Work
item.description: The Pala Band of Mission Indians and the Pala Environmental Department announce that San Diego Gas & Electric (SDG&E) has contracted PAR Western Line Contractors LLC to perform utility pole work near Highway 76, between Sacred Mountain Way and Pala Del Norte, from December 1, 2025, to December 4, 2025, from 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

item.title: In Memoriam: Theodore Henry Smith (1992-2025)
item.description: The Pala Band of Mission Indians mourns the passing of community member Theodore "Teddy" Henry Smith on November 16, 2025.

item.title: Memorial: Christopher J. Lawton
item.description: The Pala Band of Mission Indians mourns the passing of community member Christopher J. Lawton on December 4, 2024.

item.title: Notice: Office Closure for the Christmas Holiday
item.description: In observance of the Christmas Holiday, the Pala Admin Building, Pala Transfer Station, and Pala Postal will be closed on Wednesday, December 24, 2025, and Thursday, December 25, 2025.

item.title: Notice: Office Closure for New Year’s Holiday
item.description: In observance of the New Year's Holiday, the Pala Admin Building, Pala Transfer Station, and Pala Postal will be closed on Thursday, January 1, 2026.

item.title: In Memoriam: Helen Jean Morones (1943-2025)
item.description: The Pala Band of Mission Indians mourns the passing of community member Helen Jean Morones on December 21, 2025.

item.title: Emergency Alert: Water Service Shutoff
item.description: Pala, CA – The Pala Band of Mission Indians has issued a Pala Emergency Alert (PEA) for a water service shutoff on Wednesday, January 21, 2026, from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. for all areas east of Pala Temecula Road. Plan in advance for drinking water, cooking, and bathing.

item.title: Emergency Alert: Water Service Shutoff
item.description: Pala, CA – The Pala Band of Mission Indians has issued a Pala Emergency Alert (PEA) for a water service shutoff on Wednesday, January 28, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. for all areas on Cactus Road. Plan in advance for drinking water, cooking, and bathing.

item.title: Notice: Office Closure for Presidents’ Day
item.description: PALA, CA – In observance of Presidents' Day, the Pala Admin Building, Pala Transfer Station, and Pala Postal will be closed on Monday, February 16, 2026.

item.title: Announcement: 51st Cupa Days
item.description: The Pala Band of Mission Indians and the Cupa Cultural Center announce the 50th Cupa Days, which will take place on Saturday, May 3, 2025, from 10:00 a.m. to dusk, and Sunday, May 4, 2025, from 11:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Cupa Cultural Center Grounds.
